official.deadline_note: No exact date is published: NU's Financial Aid & Scholarships page lists the 2027-2028 financial support application deadline for ALL categories (NUET Applicants including international applicants; international SAT/ACT applicants; and IB Diploma, A-Level/NIS Grade 12, Olympiad winners for undergraduate) as 'October 2026 - To be announced later', and the 'Dates of NUET 2027' as 'To be announced later'. Published last test dates for financial support consideration: SAT 05.12.2026, ACT 28.11.2026.
official.application_cycle: 2027-2028 academic year cycle (final certificates issued in 2025 and 2026 are accepted for the 2027-2028 academic year; test results must not expire before 1 August 2027)
official.status_note: The official Financial Aid & Scholarships page publishes the current-round application period as 'October 2026 - To be announced later' for every category, so the 2027-2028 round is open with exact dates still to be announced; deadlines are extended by separate announcement (e.g. the 2026-2027 international deadline was extended to 10 February 2026).
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published tuition fees for one academic year: Foundation Year Program $12,000; Undergraduate programs $15,000 (for residents of the Republic of Kazakhstan, payments are processed in the national currency at the University's internal exchange rate of 486 KZT per 1 USD). The Abai Scholarship 'covers the tuition fee, medical insurance, and a monthly stipend'.
benefits: Abai Scholarship: 'There are merit-based Abay Kunanbayev scholarships available for top international candidates, as recommended by the admissions committee of each school. This scholarship covers the tuition fee, medical insurance, and a monthly stipend.'

Tuition fee for the Foundation Year Program or undergraduate programme is covered by financial support; published tuition fees are $12,000 (Foundation Year) and $15,000 (undergraduate) per academic year
Medical insurance (published as part of the Abai Scholarship)
Monthly stipend (published as part of the Abai Scholarship)
25% tuition coverage for winners of international and national academic subject Olympiads (undergraduate programmes), per the published list of Olympiads
eligibility: Applicant must first receive an admission offer in the Personal Account, then click 'Submit Financial Support Application' to complete the financial support application

Applicant must select one of six categories - NUET Applicants, SAT/ACT Applicants, Winners of International and/or Republican Subject Olympiads, IB Diploma Holders, A-Level/NIS Grade 12 Certificate Holders, NUFYP Students; 'Application for financial support is considered if the applicant meets the minimum requirements for the selected category. If the established requirements are not met, the application will not be considered.'

NUFYP (Foundation Year) entry: IELTS 5.5 (writing & reading 5.5, listening & speaking 5.0) or equivalent TOEFL, plus Digital SAT 1140 or ACT 24 (SAT/ACT published as ONLY FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS); Undergraduate entry: IELTS 6.0 (writing 6.0; reading, listening & speaking 5.5) or equivalent TOEFL, plus Digital SAT 1240 or ACT 26, IB Diploma 30 total with 4, 4, 5 in three Higher Level subjects, or A-Level/NIS Grade 12 not less than ABB in any three subjects
NUET: 120 total score with a minimum of 50 in each of Mathematics and Critical Thinking and Problem Solving

Olympiad winners: International Olympiad gold, silver or bronze (I, II, III place) within the last three years, or Republican Olympiad gold or silver (I, II place) in the current academic year, with an interview required
Only final-year students and graduates of secondary/post-secondary educational organizations may apply to NUFYP; NUFYP is a full-time programme and studies cannot be combined with high school
requirements: IELTS/TOEFL must be taken in person at a test centre: IELTS Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition and TOEFL PDT are not considered, and results are considered without superscoring; results are valid only if they do not expire before 1 August 2027
Official electronic IELTS/TOEFL results must be sent through the Testing Center and a scanned copy uploaded to the Personal Account (code for IELTS: NU, Admissions Office; code for TOEFL iBT: 6762)

SAT/ACT certificates are considered without superscoring, must be taken in person, must not expire before 1 August 2027, and official electronic results must be sent through the Testing Center (College Board) with a scanned copy uploaded (SAT - 7915, ACT - 5521)
Last test dates for financial support consideration: SAT 05.12.2026, ACT 28.11.2026
Olympiad category: results must be submitted before the application deadline; IELTS/TOEFL scores are required but there is no minimum score
A-Level/NIS Grade 12 category: only final certificates issued in 2025 and 2026 are accepted for admission to the 2027-2028 academic year
documents: Scanned copy of the IELTS or TOEFL certificate, with official electronic results sent through the Testing Center (IELTS code NU, Admissions Office; TOEFL iBT code 6762)
Official electronic SAT (7915) or ACT (5521) results sent by the College Board, plus a scanned copy of the certificate
Final IB Diploma results, or final A-Level/NIS Grade 12 certificates issued in 2025 or 2026
Olympiad results documentation submitted before the application deadline, if applying under the Olympiad category
NUET result, if applying under the NUET category, plus payment of the NUET fee of 7,000 KZT (applications without NUET fee payment will not be processed)
An original of a passport or a national identity card uploaded to the Personal Account (required to take the entry exam)
selection_criteria: 'Application for financial support is considered if the applicant meets the minimum requirements for the selected category. If the established requirements are not met, the application will not be considered.'
Abai Scholarships are merit-based and available for top international candidates, as recommended by the admissions committee of each school
Shortlisting by each school's admission committee, then interviews by video call or face-to-face, then final results notified by e-mail with offer letters in personal accounts
An interview is required for applicants under the Olympiad winners category
coverage: Tuition fee for the Foundation Year Program or undergraduate programme
Monthly stipend (published as part of the Abai Scholarship)
Medical insurance (published as part of the Abai Scholarship)
Published tuition fee benchmarks: $12,000 per academic year for the Foundation Year Program and $15,000 per academic year for undergraduate programmes
application_method: Apply for admission at admissions.nu.edu.kz and receive an admission offer in the Personal Account
In the Admission Results section at admissions.nu.edu.kz, click 'Submit Financial Support Application' and complete the financial support application form

Select one of the six published categories and upload the documents confirming the results for that category (uploading documents is not required for the NUET category; for NUET the applicant must choose a test city and pay the NUET fee)
Submit the application; after submission, changes to the application form and uploaded documents cannot be made

The Admissions Office reviews the application and emails the applicant any documents that need correction with a correction deadline; incomplete or incorrectly submitted applications that remain uncorrected will not be considered, and applicants are advised to check the Spam folder
official.application_route: Admissions portal admissions.nu.edu.kz: submit the admission application first, receive an offer, then file a separate 'Submit Financial Support Application' form in the Personal Account under one category with its supporting documents
official.study_mode: Full-time (NUFYP is published as a full-time programme; the undergraduate programme is a four-year higher education programme)
official.citizenship_residency: International candidates are welcome to apply; the Digital SAT/ACT categories are published as 'ONLY FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS' and the Abai Scholarship is for top international candidates. Other NU financial-aid categories published on the Fees and Financial Support page are restricted to citizens of Kazakhstan (75% tuition coverage for socially vulnerable categories of citizens of Kazakhstan; 50% tuition coverage for employees of Kazakhstan's government institutions and enterprises).
official.international_eligibility: Yes - international candidates may apply, including under the SAT/ACT category that is published only for international applicants; international deadlines may differ from those for candidates from Kazakhstan and all applications must be submitted through admissions.nu.edu.kz
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The Olympiad winners category is limited to the published lists: International Subject Olympiads (IMO, IPhO, IChO, IBO, IOI, International Zhautykov Olympiad in Mathematics, Physics and Informatics, International Mendeleyev Chemistry Olympiad) and Republican Subject Olympiads of the Republic of Kazakhstan (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Informatics)
official.duration: NUFYP: one-year intensive preparatory programme for admission to the University's undergraduate programme; undergraduate programmes: four-year higher education programme leading to an academic bachelor's degree
official.description: Nazarbayev University publishes financial support for applicants who obtain the minimum passing scores on the entrance exams and submit the required certificates in accordance with the admission requirements; applicants must hold an admission offer and then submit a separate financial support application under one published category. For international candidates NU describes merit-based Abay Kunanbayev scholarships for top international candidates, as recommended by the admissions committee of each school, covering the tuition fee, medical insurance, and a monthly stipend. The current round is the 2027-2028 academic year cycle, with the application period published as October 2026 and exact dates to be announced.
official.program_type: University financial aid and merit scholarship (Abai Scholarship for international candidates)
official.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 overall for the Foundation Year Program (NUFYP) with writing & reading 5.5 and listening & speaking 5.0, or IELTS 6.0 overall for undergraduate programmes with writing 6.0 and reading, listening & speaking 5.5, or the equivalent TOEFL score as posted on the ETS website. For the Olympiad winners category IELTS/TOEFL scores are required but there is no minimum score. Tests must be taken in person at a test centre (IELTS Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition and TOEFL PDT are not considered), results are considered without superscoring, IELTS One Skill Retake is accepted with the original certificate date used, and results are valid only if they do not expire before 1 August 2027. The language of instruction at NU is English.

travel_coverage (no travel or installation allowance is published)

verification.notes: Checked the official NU Financial Aid & Scholarships page for Foundation & Undergraduate (categories, minimum scores, English rules, documents, 4-step submission flow and Important Dates), the Fees and Financial Support page (published tuition fees of $12,000/$15,000 and aid rules for other categories) and the International Admission General Information page (Abai Scholarship coverage: tuition fee, medical insurance, monthly stipend). NU publishes no cash figure for the award or stipend, so amount fields are null; the 2027-2028 deadline is published only as 'October 2026 - To be announced later'.

applicant_utility.summary: Treat this as a two-gate process: you must first win a Nazarbayev University admission offer and only then file a separate financial support application inside your Personal Account under one of six published categories. For the 2027-2028 cycle NU has published only 'October 2026 - To be announced later' for every category and 'To be announced later' for NUET 2027 dates, so the page and your Personal Account need weekly checking rather than one visit. International applicants should anchor on the SAT/ACT route, whose final usable test dates for this cycle are 5 December 2026 (SAT) and 28 November 2026 (ACT), and make sure their in-person IELTS/TOEFL certificate stays valid beyond 1 August 2027. NU publishes no stipend amount, so pair any award with the University's own estimate of roughly USD 400 per month in living costs on campus.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong international applicants holding in-person SAT/ACT, IB, A-Level/NIS Grade 12 or recognised olympiad results who can also produce an English certificate that stays valid past 1 August 2027
application_readiness_checklist: Create the admissions.nu.edu.kz Personal Account and complete the admission application first; nothing on the funding side can start without an offer
Pick exactly one funding category and make sure your evidence actually meets that category's minimum, because a mismatch means the application is not considered at all
Have the testing centre send electronic results as well as uploading scans: IELTS code 'NU, Admissions Office', TOEFL iBT code 6762, SAT code 7915, ACT code 5521
Confirm every certificate's validity date sits after 1 August 2027 and that the tests were taken in person, not online or at home
If using the NUET category, pay the 7,000 KZT NUET fee within the deadline and choose a test city, or the application is not processed
Whitelist NU mail and check Spam for the Admissions Office correction email, and correct documents inside the stated window
common_rejection_risks: Applying under a category whose minimum you do not actually meet - published as grounds for the application not being considered
Entering through the fee-paying admissions route, which NU states removes eligibility for financial aid
NUET fee left unpaid, which NU states stops the application being processed
Submitting the financial support form before realising a document is wrong: the form and uploads are locked after submission and can only be corrected if the Admissions Office emails you
Incomplete applications that are submitted and then never corrected within the correction deadline

Olympiad or A-Level/NIS Grade 12 certificates outside the published windows (last three years for international olympiads, current year for republican olympiads, 2025-2026 certificates only for A-Level/NIS Grade 12)
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: NU publishes an average monthly cost of attendance of approximately USD 400 on campus - about USD 300 on-campus dining, USD 55 dormitory accommodation, USD 15 transportation, USD 8 laundry, USD 10 sports centre membership and USD 5 additional medical insurance. The Abai Scholarship's monthly stipend amount is not published, so plan for living costs to fall substantially on you, plus visa, flights and any cost of sitting the tests (NUET 7,000 KZT), none of which are published as covered.
document_audit: Electronic results sent by the testing centre AND a scanned copy in the Personal Account are both required - a scan alone fails, and so do results the centre never transmitted
In-person tests only: NU rejects IELTS Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition and TOEFL PDT, and applies no superscoring to IELTS/TOEFL or SAT/ACT
Only final A-Level/NIS Grade 12 certificates issued in 2025 or 2026 count for the 2027-2028 year, and IB results are read against 30 total with 4, 4, 5 in three Higher Level subjects
An original passport or national identity card must already be uploaded to the Personal Account to sit the entrance exam
For the olympiad category, IELTS/TOEFL is still compulsory even though no minimum score applies
alerts: Deadlines are genuinely not yet fixed for this cycle ('October 2026 - To be announced later' for all categories, NUET 2027 dates 'To be announced later'), so last-minute applicants risk a very short window
The final test dates for financial support consideration are fixed even though application dates are not: SAT 05.12.2026 and ACT 28.11.2026
Every certificate must not expire before 1 August 2027 - an otherwise perfect file fails on an expired English certificate
Accepting the fee-paying admissions route voids financial aid, so decide which competition you are entering before you accept anything
NUET results take roughly six weeks, there is no appeal procedure, and any test violation cancels both the result and the financial support application
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply through admissions.nu.edu.kz, wait for an offer in the Personal Account, then open 'Submit Financial Support Application', choose one category, upload that category's evidence, submit once, and track the Admissions Office email for corrections and the final decision
